mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TBL_PAYMENT_TERMS t LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON t.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE t.IS_DELETED = 0
AND t.TERMS_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.termsCode}, '%')
AND t.TERMS_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.termsName}, '%')
AND t.SUPPLIER_ID = #{param.supplierId}
AND t.STATUS = #{param.status}
AND (t.TERMS_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR t.TERMS_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY t.CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_PAYMENT_TERMS t LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON t.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE t.TERMS_ID = #{termsId} AND t.IS_DELETED = 0
SELECT * FROM TBL_PAYMENT_TERMS WHERE TERMS_CODE = #{termsCode} AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT FROM TBL_PAYMENT_TERMS t LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON t.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE (t.SUPPLIER_ID = #{supplierId} OR t.SUPPLIER_ID IS NULL) AND t.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY t.SUPPLIER_ID DESC, t.PAYMENT_DAYS ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_PAYMENT_TERMS t LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON t.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE t.IS_DELETED = 0 AND t.STATUS = 1 ORDER BY t.TERMS_CODE ASC
